name: Aratte! Onii-chan / Sawa Ani Vol. 2
original_name: あらって!お兄ちゃん/さわ兄Vol.2
source:
I'm tasked with helping my young sister Karina bathe after she ended up breaking a bone.
I was perfectly willing to help out, but when Karina's lewd actions escalate,
I'm not sure how to respond...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ294812.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的妹妹卡琳娜骨折后，我的任务是帮她洗澡。
我非常愿意帮忙，但当卡琳娜的猥亵行为升级时，
我不知道该如何回应…

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ294812.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
